name: Train Vs Car 99
desc:
Welcome to Train Vs Car 99!

Put your vehicles onto tracks and create Epic Moments as your vehicle crumbles into a million parts! 🚗💥 Play around with different ways to destroy our cars and trucks! 🚛💨 Drive your own train at HIGH speeds into objects! 🚂💨

🧨 Stay in the game for 10 minutes to earn 1000 parts!

🎬 Create funny and crazy moments while making a video of you playing the game. To get cash and parts, drive your vehicle onto the tracks and watch the train hit it  BOOM! 💥

🏆 Be No. 1 on the leaderboard to show off your skills and look cool 😎. Use parts to buy explosives 🧨 and make the game even more fun 🤩. Enjoy! Buy a private server it’s worth 25 Robux!
